title: Make your own report
summary: How to add comparison columns, your own notes or calculations to the profit and loss, and save it to use again.

steps.text: Open the profit and loss and click Customise. Every tick changes the report straight away.

image.description: The profit and loss with the Customise panel open. Last period and percent of income are ticked, so the report shows two periods and a percent of income column. The panel also lists Same period last year, Month by month, the rows, and New column.

steps.text: Under Start from, click Compare quarters, Month by month, or For the accountant to begin from a ready layout.
Tick columns: Last period, Same period last year, % of income, or Month by month. Tick rows: accounts with no amounts, small expenses grouped as Other, or account codes.
Click New column to add your own: notes you type in each row, or a calculation picked from a list, such as the difference between two columns. Check the preview, then click Add column.
Click Save as my report and give it a name, such as Quarterly P&L for accountant. It is listed under My reports, above the standard ones.
Open it from Reports at any time: its figures always come from your books. Rename or Delete it from the list.
